layouts.prompt: Single 16:9 anime storyboard still. Image 1 supplies the exact anime officer identity and navy-gold uniform. Put the officer toward the back right by the rose chair, seated, with a playfully startled grin, legs in ivory trousers mostly obscured by the dark round table. His navy-and-gold glove-free hand reaches over the table toward the left foreground, carrying the single smooth solid round gold baton of Image 3, whose end is strongly foreshortened near camera. Warm amber stage light from beyond the left edge glows softly on the front of the prop and table. Keep the dark door and beige warm wall, replace markings with blank blur. One character, cel-shaded linework matching Image 1. No muzzle, realistic weapon, extra person or text.
